environment.description: Container running on EKS with default security context. Pod spec uses default service account with no PodSecurityPolicy or PodSecurityStandard enforcement. Container runs as root (UID 0) with full default capability set. No network policy restricting egress. The /api/v1/debug/exec endpoint is accessible from the internal network.

config.capabilities: default Docker set (includes CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE, etc.)
